headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Lines Shift
war_summary: The latest returns show the ownership war still concentrated in a handful of unsettled sectors, though the tempo has changed since the last edition. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ledger, with 39 base events in 24 hours, including five in the latest two-hour span; its holdings stand at seven Colonial, two Warden, and none neutral. Stlican Shelf follows with 27 events, but only one recently, while its nine bases remain divided six Colonial to three Warden. Nevish Line records 17 events and two in the latest window, with five Warden and three Colonial bases. Kuura Strand has sustained its sharp activity, posting four events in two hours and 11 in the day, with five Warden and one Colonial base. Palantine Berm also reports four recent events among 12 for the day, its seven bases split five Warden and two Colonial. Callahan’s Passage has become newly active since the previous report, with three events in two hours and ten across the day; eight bases are Warden-held and two Colonial. Other fronts show fighting or enlistment movement without recorded ownership changes, and no victor is declared.
